question: Could you help me calculate the average single career span value in years for all baseball players? Please precise the result as a float number. First, calculate the difference in years, months, and days between the debut and final game dates. For each player, the career span is computed as the sum of the absolute number of years, plus the absolute number of months divided by 12, plus the absolute number of days divided by 365. Round each part to two decimal places before summing. Finally, average the career spans and round the result to a float number.
sql:
WITH player_dates AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        CAST(NULLIF(debut, '') AS DATE) AS debut_date,
        CAST(NULLIF(final_game, '') AS DATE) AS final_date
    FROM player 
    WHERE NULLIF(debut, '') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(final_game, '') IS NOT NULL
),
calc AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        debut_date,
        final_date,
        (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM final_date) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM debut_date)) AS yr,
        (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM final_date) - EXTRACT(MONTH FROM debut_date)) AS mo,
        (EXTRACT(DAY FROM final_date) - EXTRACT(DAY FROM debut_date)) AS dy
    FROM player_dates
),
step1 AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        debut_date,
        final_date,
        yr,
        CASE WHEN dy < 0 THEN mo - 1 ELSE mo END AS mo,
        CASE WHEN dy >= 0 THEN dy ELSE dy + EXTRACT(DAY FROM DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', final_date) - INTERVAL '1' DAY) END AS dy
    FROM calc
),
step2 AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        debut_date,
        final_date,
        CASE WHEN mo < 0 THEN yr - 1 ELSE yr END AS years,
        CASE WHEN mo < 0 THEN mo + 12 ELSE mo END AS months,
        dy AS days
    FROM step1
),
career_spans AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        ROUND(ABS(years), 2) + ROUND(ABS(months), 2) / 12.0 + ROUND(ABS(days), 2) / 365.0 AS career_span
    FROM step2
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as count_players, ROUND(AVG(career_span), 2) AS avg_career_span FROM career_spans
